examples.trans: Alright, it is time for me to go and work with the groceries.

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'казать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'say', paired with 'говорить'.

examples.text: Я рассказала о нашем поцелуе, и мы расстались.
examples.trans: I told him about our kiss, and we broke up.

examples.text: Если хочешь, мы можем ему сразу правду сказать.
examples.trans: If you want, we can tell him the truth right away.

examples.text: Что ты сказал?
examples.trans: What did you say?

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian personal or demonstrative pronoun meaning 'what, that', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Никак, это было просто чтобы Катя поревновала.
examples.trans: Nothing at all, that was just to make Katya jealous.

examples.text: Слушай, а Света знает, что у вас ничего нет?
examples.trans: Listen, does Sveta know that there is nothing between you two?

examples.text: Потому что он уже давно сидит здесь.
examples.trans: Because he has been sitting here for a long time already.

meanings.en: to think up, to invent, to come up with
meanings.note: Prefix 'при-' indicates approaching, attachment, or slight degree of action (stem 'думать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'came up with', paired with 'придумывать'.

examples.text: Скажи, что ты придумал на этот раз?
examples.trans: Tell me, what did you come up with this time?

examples.text: Ты сам это придумал!
examples.trans: You came up with this yourself!

examples.text: Я придумаю план.
examples.trans: I'll think up a plan.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian personal or demonstrative pronoun meaning 'we', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Я рассказала о нашем поцелуе, и мы расстались.
examples.trans: I told him about our kiss, and we broke up.

examples.text: Так на чём мы с тобой остановились?
examples.trans: So where did you and I leave off?

examples.text: Мы с тобой говорили о моём Никите.
examples.trans: You and I were talking about my Nikita.

meanings.note: Prefix 'раз-' ('apart, un-, thoroughly') indicates distribution or intensive action (stem 'водить'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to raise / breed'.

examples.text: Мы будем разводить свежих устриц здесь, в России.
examples.trans: We will raise fresh oysters here in Russia.

examples.text: Валя, ты повторяешься, устриц ты уже разводил.
examples.trans: Valya, you are repeating yourself, you already raised oysters.

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'вежий'). Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('fresh').

examples.text: Там сейчас свежее мясо должны привезти, проконтролируй.
examples.trans: They are supposed to deliver fresh meat there right now, go check it.

examples.text: Мы будем разводить свежих устриц здесь, в России.
examples.trans: We will raise fresh oysters here in Russia.

examples.text: Виктор Петрович, нам сейчас свежий изюм привезли.
examples.trans: Viktor Petrovich, they just delivered fresh raisins to us.

meanings.note: Prefix 'у-' marks departure, removal, or successful completion (stem 'стрица'). Common feminine noun meaning 'oysters' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Мы будем разводить свежих устриц здесь, в России.
examples.trans: We will raise fresh oysters here in Russia.

examples.text: Валя, ты повторяешься, устриц ты уже разводил.
examples.trans: Valya, you are repeating yourself, you already raised oysters.

examples.text: Вы, конечно же, слышали об устричных фермах?
examples.trans: You have, of course, heard about oyster farms?

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian conversational adverb meaning 'here', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: У него здесь сегодня назначена важная встреча.
examples.trans: He has an important meeting scheduled here today.

examples.text: Потому что он уже давно сидит здесь.
examples.trans: Because he has been sitting here for a long time already.

examples.text: Ты что здесь вообще делаешь в Москве?
examples.trans: What are you even doing here in Moscow?

meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'вторяться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'you are repeating yourself'.

related.gloss: to you are repeating yourself (base verb)
not to you are repeating yourself (negated infinitive)

examples.text: Надо всё сделать и повторяться вовремя.
examples.trans: We need to do everything and you are repeating yourself on time.

examples.text: На нашей кухне все умеют повторяться.
examples.trans: In our kitchen everyone knows how to you are repeating yourself.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian conversational adverb meaning 'already', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Со своим парнем, точнее его уже нет.
examples.trans: With my boyfriend, or rather he is gone now.

examples.text: Потому что он уже давно сидит здесь.
examples.trans: Because he has been sitting here for a long time already.

examples.text: Валя, неужели это правда ты приехал сюда?
examples.trans: Valya, did you really come here?

meanings.note: Prefix 'от-' ('away from, off') marks separation, completion, or response (stem 'лично'). Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: Сеня, вчера вечеринка у тебя получилась отличная.
examples.trans: Senya, your party yesterday turned out great.

examples.text: Не только, у меня есть отличная идея.
examples.trans: Not only that, I have an excellent idea.

examples.text: Витя, в Америке у меня всё отлично работает.
examples.trans: Vitya, in America everything works great for me.

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'коро'). Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: Ну привет, брат, сколько мы не виделись!
examples.trans: Well hello, brother, how long has it been since we saw each other!

examples.text: Ладно, пойдём скорее ко мне в кабинет.
examples.trans: Alright, let us go quickly to my office.

examples.text: Я скоро отдам всё, что тебе должен, с процентами.
examples.trans: I will soon pay back everything I owe you, with interest.

meanings.en: to give away, to hand over
meanings.note: Prefix 'от-' ('away from, off') marks separation, completion, or response (stem 'дать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'will give', paired with 'отдавать'.

examples.text: Я скоро отдам всё, что тебе должен, с процентами.
examples.trans: I will soon pay back everything I owe you, with interest.

examples.text: Но я так понимаю, ты отдашь не сейчас.
examples.trans: But as I understand it, you will not pay it back right now.

examples.text: Отдай мне ключи.
examples.trans: Give me the keys.

meanings.note: Prefix 'до-' marks reaching a boundary or finishing the remainder of an action (stem 'лжен'). Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('must').

examples.text: Там сейчас свежее мясо должны привезти, проконтролируй.
examples.trans: They are supposed to deliver fresh meat there right now, go check it.

examples.text: Я скоро отдам всё, что тебе должен, с процентами.
examples.trans: I will soon pay back everything I owe you, with interest.

examples.text: И что он должен скорее с ней помириться.
examples.trans: And that he should make peace with her soon.

meanings.note: Prefix 'про-' indicates movement through, completion, or missing the mark (stem 'цент'). Common masculine noun meaning 'with interest' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Я скоро отдам всё, что тебе должен, с процентами.
examples.trans: I will soon pay back everything I owe you, with interest.

examples.text: Они накрутили со своими бандитскими процентами.
examples.trans: They piled it on with their gangster interest rates.

examples.text: Кредит под низкий процент.
examples.trans: A loan at a low interest rate.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian conversational adverb meaning 'so', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Так на чём мы с тобой остановились?
examples.trans: So where did you and I leave off?

examples.text: Я тебя понимаю, у меня дочь такого же возраста.
examples.trans: I understand you, I have a daughter of the same age.

examples.text: А чего ты тут так громко кричишь?
examples.trans: Why are you shouting so loudly in here?

meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'нимать'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'understand', paired with 'понять'.

examples.text: Я тебя понимаю, у меня дочь такого же возраста.
examples.trans: I understand you, I have a daughter of the same age.

examples.text: Но я так понимаю, ты отдашь не сейчас.
examples.trans: But as I understand it, you will not pay it back right now.

examples.text: Конечно понимаю, если что, я в своём номере.
examples.trans: Of course I understand, if anything comes up, I am in my room.

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'ейчас').

examples.text: Там сейчас свежее мясо должны привезти, проконтролируй.
examples.trans: They are supposed to deliver fresh meat there right now, go check it.

examples.text: Привет, Света, с кем ты сейчас говорила?
examples.trans: Hi, Sveta, who were you talking to just now?

examples.text: Виктор, внимание, к нам сейчас едет Дягилев.
examples.trans: Viktor, attention, Dyagilev is on his way to us right now.
